description: A multiple: one voltage copied to three jacks, twice over, with the second group fed from the first until its own source jack is used

inputs.text: The voltage copied to Ports 2, 3 and 4, and to Ports 6, 7 and 8 as well while Port 5 is empty
The voltage copied to Ports 6, 7 and 8; putting a cable in here cuts that group off from Port 1

outputs.text: A copy of whatever is patched to Port 1, at the same number of channels, and one channel of 0V while Port 1 is empty
A copy of Port 5, or of Port 1 while Port 5 is empty, at the same number of channels, and one channel of 0V while both are empty

notes: the small triangle drawn between the fourth and fifth jacks marks the break: Port 1 feeds both groups until something is patched to Port 5.
both groups pass polyphony straight through, so a sixteen-channel cable into Port 1 comes out of all six copies with sixteen channels.
the jacks carry no printed names; hovering one shows the maker's own numbering, Port 1 through Port 8, counted downwards.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads Port 1.
